_meta.notes: The ONLY save worth a picture, because a save running RP-1's own crew rules draws nothing here at all. These five are KSP difficulty settings off RP0Settings rather than career state, so a career that took the defaults has nothing an operator has to hold, and the section that used to restate all five on every save now states only the ones a reader who assumed the defaults would be wrong about. This one has R&R switched off and both training rates moved, which are exactly those
_meta.why-retirement-is-absent: Retirement is ON here, which is RP-1's default, so it is not drawn. The extension ceiling that used to sit beside it is gone for a different reason: it is not a setting at all but Database.SettingsCrew.retireIncreaseCap, a config constant with no UI, and each kerbal's own row already says where their date can be pushed to

_scene.caption: The three crew rules this save runs differently from RP-1's own: post-flight R&R switched off, proficiency training at 0.80x and mission training at 1.25x, which is why a course's ETA is not the length the catalogue quotes
